scope: Dependency map of every link a theory of everything would need, with the current evidence for each. Not a proof score or completion percentage.

status_vocabulary.stipulated: Supplied model input or assumption; not derived.
status_vocabulary.exact_theorem: Proved within its stated model and hypotheses.
status_vocabulary.controlled_limit: Proved in a stated limit or regime only.
status_vocabulary.conditional: Follows if named, unproven hypotheses hold.
status_vocabulary.calibrated: A number fixed by matching data, not predicted.
status_vocabulary.phenomenological_fit: Formula or ansatz with fitted or chosen inputs.
status_vocabulary.obstructed: A proved or verified obstruction within a stated class; other classes remain open.
status_vocabulary.open: No result yet; a well-posed problem is named.
status_vocabulary.withdrawn: Claim falsified or withdrawn; kept for the record.

revisions.summary: Round 3: Lorentz invariance adopted as fundamental (BPR-6D); flux vacuum, flux landscape, family symmetry and Yukawa obstruction added; substrate nodes reclassified as analogue/regulator.

Round 4: characteristic-class Dirac quantization of the Green-Schwarz couplings; the minimal completion needs the parent charge in 3Z, so the family number is a multiple of three (family_count moves to conditional).
Round 5: Omega_7^Spin(B(Spin(10) x U(1))) = 0 by an exact Adams E2 computation over A(1); BPR-6D has no global anomaly for the Spin x Spin(10) x U(1) structure.

nodes.claim: One-dimensional complete Bose ring with C>0, g>=0.
nodes.limitation: One-dimensional; no observation map to physical spacetime.

nodes.claim: Uniformly bounded local encodings of superlinear-growth (e.g. 3D) graphs into the ring are excluded.
nodes.limitation: Covers bounded-dilation, bounded-fiber maps only.

nodes.claim: Nontrivial bounded short-interval conserved (Gauss-type) operators on unrestricted Bose Fock space are scalar.
nodes.limitation: Constrained, dressed or low-energy emergent gauge structures are not covered.

nodes.claim: Three-dimensional periodic cubic Bose-Hubbard lattice, C>0, g>=0; self-adjoint dynamics and one-particle nonrelativistic continuum limit.
nodes.limitation: Three-dimensional geometry is supplied, not derived; repulsive contact scattering is trivial in the continuum limit.

nodes.claim: Attractive tuned contact interaction with hard triple exclusion: fixed-N and direct-sum continuum convergence, canonical energy density, locally normal limit state.
nodes.limitation: Hard triple exclusion is an added constraint; no equilibrium phase is established.

nodes.claim: Proposed amendment: hard-core bosons on links of a 3D lattice (equivalently site bosons on its line graph) with vertex charging U and hopping t.
nodes.limitation: New model input, not derived from the site-boson substrate; lattice (cubic vs diamond) is a choice.

nodes.claim: In every fixed-N sector the cubic lattice ground state is simple, strictly positive, invariant under every graph automorphism, and overlaps the condensate; an exact lattice f-sum identity follows.
nodes.limitation: Selects the vacuum inside a supplied population; does not select N.

nodes.claim: Complete Bose-Einstein condensation with N-uniform depletion bound, and convergence of the low-lying spectrum to the Bogoliubov spectrum e=sqrt(eps(eps+2mu)), for g=lambda/(N-1) at fixed lattice size.
nodes.limitation: Mean-field limit at fixed n; not a thermodynamic limit or the dilute Gross-Pitaevskii regime.

nodes.claim: Condensation and a phonon branch in the thermodynamic limit of the cubic lattice at fixed g and density.
nodes.limitation: Proved in the literature only in special cases (hard-core bosons at half filling); nothing proved here.

nodes.claim: Local physical energy-transfer theorem making the tuned continuum limit state an equilibrium phase.
nodes.limitation: Named sufficient target (T) is unproved; no no-go is established either.

nodes.claim: The exact one-particle branch E=E0+kappa p^2 cannot satisfy a finite-c mass shell on any open band.
nodes.limitation: Excludes only the literal identification; massive nonrelativistic approximation is compatible.

nodes.claim: The Bogoliubov phonon obeys |e/(c_s|q|)-1| <= max(a^2/12, xi^2)|q|^2 exactly, with c_s^2=2 mu kappa; this realizes the relativity gate's conditional acoustic Lagrangian with derived A,B.
nodes.limitation: One scalar mode; preferred condensate frame; anisotropic lattice and superluminal Bogoliubov corrections.

nodes.claim: For uniform lattice flows the long-wave phonon cone is the null cone of an acoustic metric; it is Lorentzian iff the flow is dynamically stable, and has no ergoregion iff it is long-wave Landau stable.
nodes.limitation: Kinematic, Hartree-Bogoliubov level, uniform flows only; no curved geometries or horizons derived.

nodes.claim: All low-energy species emerging from the lattice substrate share one light cone.
nodes.limitation: At Bogoliubov level, density-coupled species never share a cone; decoupled species share one only under tuning; the photon, charges and phonons have unrelated speeds; loops and slow RG running undo tree-level tuning (literature). A naturalness obstruction, not a no-go: a new principle is needed. Bypassed, not solved, in BPR-6D, where Lorentz invariance is fundamental (doc/derivations/architecture_decision_2026-09-26.md).

nodes.claim: Three spatial dimensions.
nodes.limitation: Supplied by the cubic graph; the ring route to 3D is obstructed.

nodes.claim: Induced R+R^2 action with exact scalaron mass, plateau and slow-roll normalizations.
nodes.limitation: Action inserted by hand; bare/counterterm/cutoff freedom leaves coefficients non-identifiable. Superseded as the gravity sector by six_d_gravity in BPR-6D.

nodes.claim: G and the Planck length.
nodes.limitation: Only the ratio a/l_P is derived, conditionally; G matches by construction.

nodes.claim: Dynamical metric (tensor modes, universal coupling) from the substrate.
nodes.limitation: The acoustic metric follows condensate hydrodynamics, not Einstein equations; any emergent massless spin-2 must evade Weinberg-Witten. In BPR-6D the metric is fundamental (node six_d_gravity); this node now concerns the substrate as an analogue only.

nodes.claim: Cosmological constant from the substrate.
nodes.limitation: Energy-origin invariance leaves it underived; legacy dark-energy helpers are inconsistent. In BPR-6D a flat M4 requires one tuning of the 6D cosmological constant (flux_vacuum).

nodes.claim: Gauged dihedral point group (Postulate 0d) with a central heat-kernel Hamiltonian; 2D non-Abelian anyons.
nodes.limitation: No map to 4D SU(3)xSU(2)xU(1); coupling-to-phase map unknown.

nodes.claim: BPR 1.0 particle sector glueball ratios.
nodes.limitation: Sealed blind benchmark failed gates 2-4.

nodes.claim: Fixed five-site occupation-orbit encoding of the D5 gauge target.
nodes.limitation: Excludes that candidate only.

nodes.claim: Hard-core link bosons with a vertex charging term give, exactly to third order in t/U, a compact U(1) quantum link model with emergent Gauss law; on the diamond lattice this is the pyrochlore hard-core boson model whose Coulomb (photon) phase at large U/t is reported by quantum Monte Carlo.
nodes.limitation: U(1) only; the photon phase relies on published Monte Carlo for the diamond lattice (cubic undetermined); charges are bosonic; within one species the photon and the superfluid Goldstone mode occupy different phases (numerics plus a Higgs heuristic).

nodes.claim: Emergent SU(3) x SU(2) gauge fields from a bosonic substrate.
nodes.limitation: Non-Abelian quantum link models use fermionic rishons; no bosonic-substrate derivation exists here.

nodes.claim: Lone 6D Weyl 16 of Spin(10) with U(1)_X flux: irreducible S4 and p2 anomaly.
nodes.limitation: Excluded only as a lone parent.

nodes.claim: Unique minimal (16-component) completion: add one opposite-chirality Spin(10) spinor with zero U(1)_F charge; I8=(1/3)X^2(3S2+2X^2-p1) is cancelled by one Green-Schwarz 2-form; massless 4D content at flux 3 is exactly three chiral 16s; remaining U(1)_F anomalies are proportional to X4 and cancelled by the descended axion.
nodes.limitation: Added spinor and 2-form are inputs; local anomalies only (Omega_7 bordism and 2-form quantization unchecked); flux choice supplies n_gen; U(1)_F becomes Stuckelberg-massive with an axion and moduli left over.

nodes.claim: Characteristic-class Dirac quantization of the minimal completion's Green-Schwarz couplings holds, for any integral 2-form lattice, iff the parent's U(1)_F charge is a multiple of 3 in units of the smallest charge; one non-chiral 2-form (lattice U) suffices; the odd lattice I_{1,1} is obstructed. U(1) normalization anchored to Park-Taylor.
nodes.limitation: Torsion refinements and Omega_7 bordism not computed; minimal completion unique only in class C (16_+(1)+16_-(2) passes outside it); requires states of charge q/3, massive in BPR-6D as defined; Morrison-Taylor (2021) suggests F-theory realizations would normally make them massless; 2-form Green-Schwarz terms only.

nodes.claim: Omega_7^Spin(B(Spin(10) x U(1))) = 0, so BPR-6D with its quantized Green-Schwarz couplings has no global gauge or gravitational anomaly; for the twisted Spin x_Z2 Spin(10) x U(1) form the Z2 in Omega_7 carries a trivial anomaly.
nodes.limitation: Untwisted: exact Adams E2 = 0 in stem 7. Twisted: reduction argument (eta product formula on S^2 x Wu, branching 16 = (4,4), order bound on Omega_5^{Spin x_Z2 Spin(5)}), no numerical eta-invariant. Assumes the Dai-Freed/Witten-Yonekura framework and the standard 7D Green-Schwarz term.

nodes.claim: Three generations; the family number is a multiple of three.
nodes.limitation: n_gen = q|m| with 3 | q forced by Dirac quantization of the minimal completion in class C (gs_quantization), so n_gen is in 3Z. Three needs q=3 and |m|=1, both minimal choices (selected otherwise only by the Lambda tuning or the classical stability reading); near-minimal completions do not force 3 | n_gen. Characteristic-class level only.

nodes.claim: Physical chiral fermions from the bosonic substrate.
nodes.limitation: Jordan-Wigner is one-dimensional and charge-carrying; Nielsen-Ninomiya doubling constrains any lattice realization.

nodes.claim: Mixing-angle and mass-ratio formulas.
nodes.limitation: Fitted PMNS coefficients, conjectural mode labels, anchored masses. BPR-6D derives no mass or mixing relation; the formulas are unconnected to it (yukawa_sector).

nodes.claim: 1/alpha from (ln p)^2 + z/2 + gamma - 1/(2 pi).
nodes.limitation: p is chosen to reproduce alpha; inverse calibration.

nodes.claim: Supplied local sources select realistic non-aligned flavor.
nodes.limitation: Attractive coupling aligns sectors; direct linear source image spans five of nine directions.

nodes.claim: A measurement distinguishing BPR from conventional Bose physics.
nodes.limitation: Identical-model comparison gives no distinguishing prediction.

nodes.claim: Map the phonon's bounded Lorentz violation to a physical particle and compare with data.
nodes.limitation: No physical particle is identified with the phonon.

nodes.claim: BPR-6D: six-dimensional Lorentz-invariant spacetime with Einstein gravity, Spin(10) x U(1)_F, the minimal chiral completion and a Green-Schwarz 2-form, on M4 x S^2 with flux 3; the lattice substrate becomes an analogue/regulator.
nodes.limitation: A decision, not a derivation: spacetime is no longer derived and the common light cone holds by assumption. Anomalies cancel locally, with Dirac-quantized Green-Schwarz couplings (parent charge 3; gs_quantization) and globally (global_anomalies) for the Spin x Spin(10) x U(1) structure. U(1)_F is Stueckelberg-massive.

nodes.claim: Six-dimensional Einstein gravity (M^4/2) R_6 - Lambda; after compactification a massless 4D graviton with universal coupling.
nodes.limitation: Supplied; non-renormalizable effective theory with cutoff of order M; G is related to the U(1)_F coupling (M_Pl^2 = pi m^2/e^2) but not predicted.

nodes.claim: M4 x S^2 with U(1)_F flux m solves the 6D equations with r = m/(2 M^2 e) when Lambda = 2 M^8 e^2/m^2; the breathing mode is stable with mass exactly 1/r0; M_Pl^2 = pi m^2/e^2 and 1/r = 2 g4 M_Pl/m.
nodes.limitation: Classical; one tuning of Lambda; only the breathing mode derived (other Einstein-Maxwell fluctuations cited from RSS 1983; Spin(10), fermion and 2-form fluctuations not covered); no one-loop, axion or Stueckelberg corrections; r = (m/2 g4) l_P with g4 unknown, so the sphere is near-Planckian only if g4 is not tiny; classical control needs g4 below an O(1), convention-dependent bound.

nodes.claim: The vacuum selects flux m=3 (three families).
nodes.limitation: Classical Einstein-Maxwell: at fixed Lambda only one flux sector is flat, lower fluxes are AdS and fluxes above (2/sqrt 3) m0 have no vacuum; the choice of m is the Lambda tuning. Quantum corrections and supersymmetric embeddings are open. With the parent at charge 3, three families is one flux quantum, and at its tuned Lambda it is the only flux sector with a compactified minimum (gs_quantization).

nodes.claim: The three flux families form one triplet of the gauged SU(2) isometry of the round sphere; massive levels m^2 r^2 = (l+1/2)^2 - k^2/4.
nodes.limitation: Round sphere assumed; the SU(2) family gauge bosons need a high-scale breaking that is not supplied.

nodes.claim: Yukawa couplings of the three flux families in BPR-6D.
nodes.limitation: The minimal content has no field in 16x16 = 10+120+126, so no Yukawa at all. For extensions, an all-orders selection rule (perturbative in U(1)_F) leaves only an F-charge -2 internal one-form 10 or 126 in the J=2 channel; scalars and the 120 never couple. SO(12) gauge-Higgs gives paired, even families and a vacuum instability. 10-only Higgs gives M_d = M_e^T (excluded); complex J=2 vevs reach every spectrum, so no mass ratio is predicted.
